approval.statement: Treat the explicit corrected finite-chain iid model and support-safe extended-rate theorem as the governing GJ18 formalization target; record all added conditions and archival deltas in the report.

governing_corrections.clause: The finite ordered seller carrier has M >= 2 types and an explicit uniform prior.
governing_corrections.relation: Makes the denominator and adjacent-pair domain explicit.

governing_corrections.clause: For every seller type theta, 0 < g(theta) <= 1 and n_k(theta)=floor(k g(theta)).
governing_corrections.relation: Makes the diverging-sample and at-most-one-match conditions explicit.

governing_corrections.clause: The aggregate averages exactly n_k(theta) rating observations.
governing_corrections.relation: Corrects the displayed off-by-one sum endpoint.

governing_corrections.clause: There are at least two rating levels; cross-type strict upper tails apply only above the bottom cutoff; no terminal full-support condition is imposed.
governing_corrections.relation: Repairs vacuous and impossible endpoint cases without weakening the ranking conclusion.

governing_corrections.clause: Ratings are conditionally iid by seller type and independent across seller histories; the horizon state is the induced finite product law.
governing_corrections.relation: Replaces the archive recurrence as the governing state-evolution clause.

governing_corrections.clause: The adjacent-pair minimum ranges over 0 <= i <= M-2.
governing_corrections.relation: Corrects an endpoint that can name theta_M.

governing_corrections.clause: The Legendre and threshold infimum use extended-real arithmetic; the final rate is separately proved finite.
governing_corrections.relation: Corrects the rate codomain for infeasible thresholds.

governing_corrections.clause: The weak-inversion and 1-P_k rates are proved directly for finite iid product laws with the required fixed-constant comparison.

human_review.source: v11 PaperInterface claim surface; human entries are recorded after direct review

main_caveat: Formalized for the author-approved corrected finite-chain model, not asserted identical to the pinned archival TeX. The corrected model makes the type-count, positive match-rate, iid state-law, endpoint-tail, and extended-rate clauses explicit; the report records each archival delta.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Every visible theorem premise represented in Assumptions.lean must be judged as an exact archival or author-approved corrected-model condition rather than proof debt; premise rows do not receive independent source-theorem credit.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Use the source-presentation-first normal inventory: only the three active named mathematical results in the pinned TeX receive ordinary coverage credit. Corrected targets retain the archival delta and approval record; formulas, diagnostics, and unnumbered convergence prose remain support or deep-audit material.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Classify every boundary-shaped input and recursive record field by expanded semantic content. Bare carrier or model data are witness data; proposition-valued fields need exact archival or correction evidence or a Lean derivation. Do not infer a source model from record, field, theorem, or function names.

llm_statement_review.policy: For every selected source claim, compare only its exact byte-pinned raw source-anchor bundle and Lean's expanded transparent `...Spec : Prop` target. The paired proof endpoint receives separate Lean-Meta proof credit; a name, paraphrase, wrapper, or prior aggregate receipt is not a semantic match. Review every retained paper-local prerequisite and every material library prerequisite before the dependent claim.

semantic_model_review.policy: Review every expanded paper-facing model surface semantically against the pinned TeX and author-approved correction. Record not-applicable only after inspecting the carrier, probability, conditioning, expectation, partition, and rate semantics; names are routing only. Detected endpoint, state-law, conditioning, and extended-rate shapes require a checked bridge.

source_proof_fidelity_review.policy: Use schema 2. The author-approved corrected model is the target; the archival recurrence and unrestricted Real display remain recorded deltas, never derivations of the corrected iid or extended-rate result. Deep observations receive no normal proof credit, and a weaker Lean conclusion or caller-supplied premise is never exact named-result evidence.
